source_citation: Archer, Shay and Johns (2017), JGR Oceans 122, 9189-9208, doi:10.1002/2017JC013286.
source_locator: Sections 2.2 and 3.4; Table 1 measurement depth; Table 2 width row and note; Figure 9 caption and section 6 item 5.
source_access: Publisher HTML and original NOAA PDF inspected, including Table 2 and Figure 9. PDF SHA256 matches the NOAA repository receipt. Gray monthly mean curve has a separate extraction artifact; raw HF radar arrays remain unavailable.
boundary_rule: Distance between both jet edges at 50% of the instantaneous core speed in the jet-coordinate downstream velocity profile; author applies a 40 h Hanning temporal filter to the jet metrics.

reported_statistics.confidence_method: Student t distribution with effective degrees of freedom based on integral timescale

exclusions: The 80 by 100 km radar observation area, channel width and core meander range are separate spatial quantities.
The 41-76 km span combines two observed years with gaps, including a 40-day radar outage after Hurricane Wilma; no year-specific extrema extracted.
Mean confidence allowance, standard deviation and observed minimum/maximum describe distinct statistics.
Width of a mean velocity profile is not the mean of per-time diagnosed widths; do not add the approximate 20 and 40 km flank distances to replace Table 2.
No seasonal numerical frames or global current buffer can be reconstructed from the reported peak phase alone.
remaining_gates: Recover year-specific monthly values and the source within-month variability envelope or original arrays.
Recover matched geographic boundary coordinates before physical map animation.
